action.action-desc: Ms. DelBene (for herself and Mr. Welch) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned

form.official-title: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to remove cost-sharing responsibilities for chronic care management services under the Medicare program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Chronic Care Management Improvement Act.

section.header: Removing cost-sharing responsibilities for chronic care management services under part B of the Medicare program

subsection.text: Section 1833 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395l) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subsection (a)(1), by striking subparagraph (Z) and inserting the following: (Z) with respect to chronic care management services (as described in section 1848(b)(8)) furnished on or after January 1, 2021, the amount paid shall be an amount equal to 100 percent of the lesser of the actual charge for such services or the amount determined under section 1848,; and

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (9), by striking and at the end; and

in paragraph (10), by striking the period at the end and inserting the following: , and (11) such deductible shall not apply with respect to chronic care management services (as described in section 1848(b)(8)) furnished on or after January 1, 2021..

paragraph.text: Section 1833(a) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395l(a)) is amended—

subclause.text: by striking subparagraph (B) and inserting subparagraphs (B), (C), and (D); and
by striking or at the end; and

clause.text: by adding at the end the following new subparagraphs:

subparagraph.text: with respect to Federally qualified health center services (other than such services that are described in clause (i) or (ii) of subparagraph (D)) furnished on or after the implementation date of the prospective payment system under section 1834(o) for which payment is made under such section, the amounts paid shall be 80 percent of the lesser of the actual charge or the amount determined under such section; and
with respect to Federally qualified health center services and rural health clinic services that are—

clause.text: personalized prevention plan services (as described in paragraph (1)(X)) or preventive services (as described in paragraph (1)(Y)) furnished on or after January 1, 2011; or
chronic care management services (as described in paragraph (1)(Z)) furnished on or after January 1, 2021;

subparagraph.text: by striking the matter following paragraph (9).

paragraph.text: Section 1834(o) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395m(o)) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (1)(A), by inserting (other than such services described in clause (i) or (ii) of section 1833(a)(3)(D)) after Federally qualified health center services; and

clause.text: in subparagraph (A), by inserting (other than such services described in clause (i) or (ii) of section 1833(a)(3)(D)) after services; and

subclause.text: by inserting (other than such services described in clause (i) or (ii) of section 1833(a)(3)(D)) after Federally qualified health center services; and
by striking section 1833(a)(1)(Z) and inserting subparagraphs (C) and (D) of section 1833(a)(3).
